_comment: Race name as the fulfillment tool knows it -> production file, relative to the Races folder (RACES_DIR). A plain string is the file; an object adds rules for picking the artboard: 'artboard' (a word its name must contain, for a file with two colorways), 'artboardExclude' (a word it must not contain, e.g. 'copy'), 'photoArtboard' (a word marking the variant with a photo window, used for orders with a photo). A key like 'Chicago Marathon / World Majors' is that race's World Majors edition. Only races listed here can be rendered; run worker/check-template.mjs before adding one.
